title: PhotoStudio
description: The PhotoStudio photo editor of this computer as an app of the workbench: the tile in ▦ and 'Open in PhotoStudio' for photos start the program on a device with CO Desktop; agents get its functions (photo info, one-click enhance, ID/passport photos) as device tools.

ui.title: PhotoStudio - photo editor of this computer
ui.label: PhotoStudio

fileActions.label: Open in PhotoStudio
fileActions.title: Edit the photo in PhotoStudio on this computer (CO Desktop)

deviceTools.name: photostudio_open
deviceTools.description: Open PhotoStudio (the photo editor of this computer) in front of the person, optionally with photos. Paths: absolute, or relative to AI-Workbench (projects/...).

deviceTools.name: photostudio_info
deviceTools.description: Camera, lens, exposure and date of a photo (JPG, TIFF, Canon CR2).

deviceTools.name: photostudio_enhance
deviceTools.description: One-click AI enhance of a photo (exposure, colour, contrast planned by the person's own Claude/Codex CLI); writes <name>.enhanced.jpg next to it unless 'out' is given. Takes up to a few minutes.

deviceTools.name: photostudio_idphoto
deviceTools.description: ID/passport photo from a portrait: crop to the spec, compliance check (local + AI), print sheet. spec e.g. be-eid (default), ua-passport, us-passport, schengen; sheet e.g. lab-10x15. Writes into 'outDir' (default: <name>.idphoto/ next to the photo) and lists the problems found.

device.warning: PhotoStudio must be installed on this computer. Agents may open photos in it and write edited copies next to the originals.
